releases.notes:
## Overview

Experimental Pathmine preview for **Minecraft Java 26.3 with Fabric**, with native Windows and Linux x64 runtimes based on NVIDIA RTX Remix. This is an independent project, not an official NVIDIA or Minecraft release.

## What's New

- Minecraft 26.3 support with Java 25 and updated rendering, window, and input integration.
- Improved world-entry readiness and terrain recapture after switching RTX.
- Colored held glass blocks and pane items, corrected weather filtering, and aligned entity PBR textures.
- Restored Copper Beacon, chest, and banner models after RTX toggles and resource reloads.
- Preserved older saved RTX zones and protected incompatible instances during installation.

## Downloads

- [Windows x64 — pathmine-fabric-26.3-0.2.0-alpha.1-windows-x64.jar](https://github.com/EyeCrasher07/Pathmine/releases/download/v0.2.0-alpha.1/pathmine-fabric-26.3-0.2.0-alpha.1-windows-x64.jar)
- [Linux x64 — pathmine-fabric-26.3-0.2.0-alpha.1-linux-x64.jar](https://github.com/EyeCrasher07/Pathmine/releases/download/v0.2.0-alpha.1/pathmine-fabric-26.3-0.2.0-alpha.1-linux-x64.jar)
- [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/EyeCrasher07/Pathmine/releases/download/v0.2.0-alpha.1/SHA256SUMS.txt)

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.3, 64-bit Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, and Fabric API 0.165.0+26.3 or a compatible newer build.
- Windows 10/11 x64: NVIDIA RTX 30-series or newer, driver 616.92+.
- Linux x64: glibc 2.36+, OpenGL/GLX/EGL libraries, and a compatible NVIDIA Vulkan ray-tracing driver.

## Installation

Install Fabric and matching Fabric API, then place Fabric API and your operating system's Pathmine JAR in `mods/`. Keep only one Pathmine version enabled. Required renderer files are bundled; first launch extracts them automatically. Any compatible launcher can be used.

## Known Limitations

**Alpha: visual parity, performance, and long-session stability remain under validation.** Other Minecraft versions, loaders, and ARM64 are unsupported by these packages. Rendering and optimization mods may conflict. The latest Windows held-glass correction still needs interactive gameplay verification.

## Testing

GitHub CI builds and tests passed on Windows and Linux. Linux verification also covered native/GPU checks and packaged gameplay, including RTX toggles and resource reloads. Automated checks do not establish complete gameplay stability.

## Documentation

[Playing and troubleshooting](https://github.com/EyeCrasher07/Pathmine/blob/v0.2.0-alpha.1/docs/PLAYING.md) · [Native Linux scope](https://github.com/EyeCrasher07/Pathmine/blob/v0.2.0-alpha.1/docs/NATIVE_LINUX_PORT.md)

releases.notes:
First experimental Pathmine preview for **Minecraft Java 1.21.1, Fabric**, with
separate Windows x86_64 and native Linux x86_64 packages. The native renderer,
material profiles and required runtime textures are bundled in each JAR.
Linux runs without Wine. This is an independent project based on NVIDIA RTX
Remix, not an official NVIDIA or Minecraft release.

Choose one package for your operating system:

- Windows x86_64: `pathmine-0.1.0-alpha.1-win64.jar`
- Linux x86_64: `pathmine-0.1.0-alpha.1-linux64.jar`

Install Java 21, Fabric Loader 0.16.5 or newer for Minecraft 1.21.1, and Fabric
API 0.116.10+1.21.1 or a compatible newer build. Put Fabric API and the selected
Pathmine JAR in your instance's `mods/` folder. Keep only one Pathmine version
enabled. Any compatible launcher can be used; no development tools or separate
SDK download are needed. The mod extracts its native payload on first launch.

These previews target NVIDIA RTX hardware with a compatible Vulkan ray-tracing
driver; consult the [platform requirements](https://github.com/EyeCrasher07/Pathmine/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.1/docs/PLAYING.md#what-you-need)
for the Windows driver/GPU target and Linux scope. Linux requires x86_64,
glibc 2.36 or newer, and the OpenGL/GLX/EGL system libraries. Windows uses the
pinned original NVIDIA runtime; Linux bundles the native runtime port and JNI
bridge built against the glibc 2.36 baseline.

This is an **alpha**, not a completed parity or compatibility release. The
existing RTX 2060 comparison covers 25 synthetic scenes: 21 are within 3/255
per channel, while four scenes still show indirect-lighting differences.
These measurements do not establish identical Minecraft gameplay, broad GPU
support, or long-session stability. Other Minecraft versions, other mod
loaders, Windows ARM64 and Linux ARM64 are not part of this release. Start
comparison tests with only Pathmine and Fabric API; optimization-mod
compatibility remains separate work.

Both packages use source commit
[`57e6d99ebdf494ed43aabe1d24579e0c12c8f924`](https://github.com/EyeCrasher07/Pathmine/commit/57e6d99ebdf494ed43aabe1d24579e0c12c8f924).
All six GitHub CI checks passed. The [Windows package build](https://github.com/EyeCrasher07/Pathmine/actions/runs/40691528922)
completed on `windows-2022`; its downloaded artifact and JAR checksums were
verified. Both JARs passed archive, platform, profile, texture and license
checks, and their 569 Java classes are byte-identical. Linux passed 805 JVM
tests, the JNI tests, all 34 native/GPU tests with Vulkan validation, and a
Java/JNI/runtime handshake using the extracted release payload in the glibc
2.36 baseline. The distribution audit checked all 10 Linux ELF libraries.
Fresh interactive Windows gameplay and long-session testing of these exact
packages have not been performed.

See the [native-port scope](https://github.com/EyeCrasher07/Pathmine/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.1/docs/NATIVE_LINUX_PORT.md)
and [playing guide](https://github.com/EyeCrasher07/Pathmine/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.1/docs/PLAYING.md)
for controls, setup and current limitations. The release includes GPL-3.0 and
all applicable upstream/vendor notices; vendor components retain their own
terms. `SHA256SUMS.txt` records the two downloadable JARs.
